lines: 05:35:48  ✦ the caretaker (speak): What shifts far ahead is not a goblin. It is grey as the wall it leans on, and it has to stoop, and when it turns the sound is stone on stone. It is unhurt and it is not in a hurry. The shortsword in your hand looks small from here — and you are carrying no armour at all, with six wounds already on you. It has not closed the distance yet. The passage behind you still runs south.
